connectionId.description: ats_connections document id as hex string — tasks are deleted with their connection

provider.description: AtsProviderEnum value the task is pushed to

cvId.description: Qorva CV the score belongs to

externalCandidateId.description: Candidate id in the external ATS

externalApplicationId.description: Application/opportunity id, when the provider separates it from the candidate

jobTitle.description: Job post title quoted in the note pushed to the ATS

headline.description: Report headline quoted in the note pushed to the ATS

reportUrl.description: Deep link back to the Qorva report

attempts.description: Send attempts made so far — capped by AtsOutboundTask.MAX_ATTEMPTS

nextAttemptAt.description: Earliest time the drain may claim this task (exponential backoff)

lastError.description: Error message from the most recent failed attempt

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the write-back was enqueued

sentAt.description: Timestamp of the successful push to the ATS
